channels.name: welcome
channels.topic: What we make and how this server works.
channels.message:
**Welcome to {server}!**

This is where you get help, updates and new releases for our products.

**Bought something?** Post your order email in {#get-customer-role} (or message {@Support Team}) and we'll unlock the 🔒 Customers area with downloads, updates and priority help.

**Just looking?** Browse {#faq}, ask in {#pre-sales-questions}, and see what others built in {#showcase}.

channels.name: rules
channels.message:
**Rules**

1. Be respectful - to customers, staff and each other.
2. **Never share paid files or licence keys.** Accounts that leak them lose access without refund.
3. No spam, ads or DMs to other members.
4. Keep support questions in the help channels so others can learn from the answers.
5. Staff decisions are final; disagreements go to {@Admin} privately.

channels.name: faq
channels.message:
**FAQ**

**How do I install a product?** Every download includes a README with step-by-step setup.
**Do I get updates?** Yes - customers get free updates for the version they bought; see {#downloads-and-updates}.
**Refunds?** Message {@Support Team} within 14 days of purchase.
**Can I use it for clients?** Check the licence file in your download - most products are single-user.

channels.name: pre-sales-questions
channels.topic: Not bought yet? Ask anything here.

channels.name: get-customer-role
channels.topic: Post your order email (not your payment details) to get the Customer role.

channels.name: open-a-ticket
channels.topic: Private support: open a private thread here (or press the ticket button if a ticket bot is set up).
channels.message:
**Need private help?** (order problems, refunds, downloads, licence keys)

1. Press the **Threads** button (or **+**) in this channel and choose **Private Thread**.
2. Name it `Order - your email` or `Refund - product name`.
3. Describe the problem. Only you and {@Support Team} can see it.

Never post card details or passwords - we'll never ask for them. General questions go in {#help-forum}.

channels.name: help-forum
channels.topic: One post per problem - include product name, what you tried, and screenshots.
channels.message: Title: product + problem. Include what you expected, what happened, and screenshots. Mark solved posts with ✅.

channels.name: downloads-and-updates
channels.message: New versions and download links are posted here. Links are personal to customers - please don't share them.

channels.name: feature-requests
channels.topic: Suggest features - one post per idea.
channels.message: One idea per post. React 👍 on ideas you want - we build the most-wanted first.
